summary: All four files contain formal mathematical content with definitions, structures, and proofs relevant to morphological theory. Basic.lean defines paradigms, paradigm systems, and complexity measures. Contiguity.lean formalizes the *ABA generalization with contiguity predicates, feasible monotonicity, and three-cell pattern theorems. Morphome.lean defines morphomes as nontrivial unnatural syncretism classes with value-conjunction naturalness. UD.lean provides bidirectional translations between analytical features and Universal Dependencies tags with round-trip theorems. Every file has formal declarations (def, structure, theorem) with proofs; none are pure import aggregators, generated data, transcripts, or stubs.
